title: Smart Data Models - Brick Schema - System
description: A functional grouping of equipment that together provide a building service, e.g. an HVAC system or a chilled water system (brick:System and its subclasses). INCOMPLETE BY DESIGN: System has no Brick-native membership property in any real Brick example checked (examples/collection/collection.ttl, examples/chiller-system/chiller-plant.ttl, examples/iaq_sensor_deployment) -- every real System instance found expresses its membership via RealEstateCore's rec:includes / rec:hasMember, not a Brick property. One of Brick's own example files even comments on this directly. This schema is therefore published as a placeholder (identity + brickClass only, no members) rather than either inventing a non-Brick property or silently omitting System altogether. A membership Relationship should be added once the planned RealEstateCore candidate exists for it to point to.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'System'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Human-readable label (rdfs:label in the source).

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

brickClass.description: Relationship. The specific Brick class of this system (e.g. https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#HVAC_System, Chilled_Water_System).
